title: InvoiceExtractionSchema
description: Strict schema for commercial invoices extracted via document processing.

vendor_name.description: Legal business or vendor name issuing the invoice.

invoice_date.description: Billing date in ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format.

total_amount.description: Final total payable amount including all taxes and fees.

tax_amount.description: Applicable sales, value-added, or goods-and-services tax.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 uppercase currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, CAD).

line_items_count.description: Total number of purchased itemized entries on the invoice.
